Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer in Friendswood, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Retail/Malls, and more. As an unarmed Patrol Officer at a retail location, you will conduct routine patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter incidents, and provide exceptional customer service and communication. Fixed-Shift Commitment (“Anchor Shifts”): You will be hired for a designated site and weekly shift that serves as your reliable base schedule
This assignment requires a six (6) month commitment

Provide customer service to clients by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and when appropriate, emergency response activities at a logistics and distribution terminal location
Respond to incidents, alarms, access-control concerns, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, following established site procedures
Conduct regular and random armed patrols of terminal grounds, entry points, perimeter areas, parking areas, and operational zones to help deter unauthorized activity
Monitor access to restricted areas, verify credentials as required, and report unusual conditions, hazards, or policy violations to appropriate personnel
Complete required activity reports, incident documentation, and shift communications in accordance with Allied Universal and site-specific requirements
